Introduction

About Me

I'm a Talent Acquisition Specialist focused on creating measurable value through HR Analytics and data-driven decision-making. I help organizations understand and address the drivers of employee turnover, strengthen talent retention, and reduce the cost of losing critical employees.

On the recruitment side, I use KPIs, analytics, and actionable insights to improve hiring efficiency, optimize recruitment channels and processes, control hiring costs, and enable HR teams to make smarter, evidence-based decisions.

Approach

How I Create Value

I turn HR data into clear answers to critical people and business questions.

I use HR analytics, KPIs, and Power BI to uncover what is driving employee turnover, where recruitment processes are losing efficiency, which talent sources deliver the strongest outcomes, and where workforce costs can be optimized.

My work goes beyond reporting performance — I connect data, identify the underlying drivers, and translate findings into actionable recommendations that help HR teams improve retention, strengthen hiring quality, reduce recruitment costs, and make more effective workforce decisions.

My objective is not simply to report what happened, but to explain why it happened, identify where action is needed, and provide HR with evidence to make better decisions.
Featured Project

HR Analytics System — Katameya Clinic Hospital

During my internship in the hospital's HR department, I designed a complete analytics system built on recruitment and turnover data — starting with raw data cleaning in Power Query, through a connected Data Model linking candidates, employees, and hiring tables, to custom DAX measures and interactive Power BI dashboards.

The dashboards helped hospital leadership identify the biggest drop-off points in the hiring journey and the leading drivers of turnover, each paired with a clear, actionable recommendation.

44% of all departures happen within the first 12 months of hire, with average tenure at resignation of just 19.1 months.
Compensation & benefits account for 39.7% of resignation reasons, followed by workload and burnout at 27.8%.
Referrals delivered the highest qualified-CV rate (65.3%) and the shortest average time-to-hire of any source.
Behind the Dashboard

The three technical steps behind every dashboard: cleaning the raw data, building the relationships, then writing the measures.

01 · Power Query

Data Cleaning & Transformation

Cleaning employee and candidate columns, removing invalid values, and converting types before loading into the model.

02 · Data Modeling

Table Relationships

Connecting Employees, Candidates, Job Requisitions, Exit Records, and Calendar into a unified star schema.

03 · DAX Measures

Custom Calculations

Writing measures such as Headcount BOP, Avg Time to Fill, and Attendance Rate to power every metric on the dashboards.
